title: Culturally-Grounded Governance for Multilingual Language Models: Rights, Data Boundaries, and Accountable AI Design

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review analyzing disparities in data quality, evaluation metrics, and model performance between high-resource and low-resource languages in collaborative settings.
Systematic literature review evaluating the misalignment between English-centric training data, abstract notions of fairness, and localized multicultural norms, values, and communication styles.
